notes.title: Abridge turns 1️⃣! 🥳🎂🎉
notes.content:
Abridge grew up so fast. Over the past year, it’s had soft-locks, hotfixes, patches, and updates. Took some time for it to learn how to crawl. Had a few rough nights and a mild head bang. Once it got it's balance, it was worth it. As it began to walk and the reviews came in, it built up our confidence that something interesting was here. It’s been wonderful and insightful to read your thoughts about it.

As time went on, Abridge participated in numerous competitions. They didn’t go as expected. However, trying its best was all it could do and it was a learning experience in itself.

I couldn’t be happier with the game. I want to say thank you to all who supported it. It wouldn’t have been possible without you!

Come and celebrate this momentous occasion with Abridge and I at a 50% discount!?!

Cheers!

Aaron A.
Eventide Game Studio

notes.title: Breath of Fresh Air - Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[*]Fix for not counting undos
[*]Fix for navigating main menu using keyboard
[*]Fix for piece to have correct color and scale after an interaction with Mouse and Controller
[*]Fix for playing last piece animation when hitting more than 2 pieces in a row
[*]Fix for incorrect level text on complete puzzle menu
[*]Fix for skewed piece after playing no move animations
[*]Fix for completion time on complete puzzle menu to show time from start of level to puzzle completion instead start of level or last restart to puzzle completion
[*]Fix for typo in In-Game options menu
[*]Fix for “Next Level” button being available in puzzle complete menu after completing last puzzle in puzzle set while progression criteria is unmet
